items.title: PayPal Announces Meta Muse Partnership. It’s a Lifeline for the Stock.
items.summary: PayPal  customers can now use Meta’s Muse artificial-intelligence consumer agent to shop and check out, PayPal said Tuesday.  Shares of PayPal rose 0.5% to $52.90 after the announcement.  Meta Platforms  stock fell 0.4% to $738.53.

items.title: Charles Schwab, JPMorgan Chase Slide On Vanguard-Backed AI Threat
items.summary: Charles Schwab led a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower on Tuesday as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Schwab's partnership news with Anthropic last week was meant to address just this kind of disruption, but may have fallen short.  Markets didn't react much on Sept. 1, when Altruist announced its new AI-powered all-in-one financial planning agent, encompassing retirement planning, investment optimization, cash flow analysis, estate planning, tax strategy, and insurance and risk.

items.title: The Nasdaq Set a Record and the Dow Lost 270 Points on the Same Morning
